rationale: The tape is effectively frozen — the last five 5-minute candles span 2 cents with a $0.01 ATR and fading volume, so there is no directional pressure to join with only 11 minutes to the close. Price sits in a mixed state (above session VWAP at 69.11 but below the 5-minute VWAP at 69.70, mid-way through a fading gap-up), giving neither side a mechanical edge, and the expected move into the close (~1-3 cents) is smaller than the cost of the spread plus slippage. Entering long or short here is a coin flip with negative expected value; flat is the correct position.
